product: Clinical-stage portfolio: opakalim (BHV-7000), a selective Kv7.2/7.3 activator in Phase 2/3 for focal epilepsy; BHV-1300 and BHV-1400 extracellular protein degraders (MoDE and TRAP) for Graves disease and IgA nephropathy; taldefgrobep alfa myostatin-activin inhibitor for obesity; BHV-1530 FGFR3 ADC and BHV-1510 TROP2 ADC in oncology; BHV-8000 TYK2/JAK1 for early Parkinsons; oral BHV-8100 PKM2 modulator.
demand: Demand is clinical and regulatory, not commercial, because nothing is marketed. Unmet need is real in refractory focal epilepsy, Graves hyperthyroidism, IgA nephropathy and obesity with muscle preservation. Evidence of demand is enrollment speed: RISE3 and the Phase 3 Graves study are fully enrolled or enrolling, with over 1,200 participants dosed across the Kv7 program.
pricing_power: None today, as there are no marketed products. Once opakalim is approved, SK Biopharmaceuticals sets price and Biohaven receives tiered royalties of mid-teens to low twenties on US net sales plus a mid-single-digit ex-US royalty. The Q2 2026 filings show no revenue from product sales, only license and collaboration economics.
competition: Epilepsy is crowded: Xenon Pharmaceuticals (azetukalner, also Kv7), SK Biopharmaceuticals XCOPRI (now a partner), UCB, Jazz and Neurocrine. IgA nephropathy includes Vera, Novartis, Otsuka and Roche; Graves disease includes Immunovant. Obesity pits taldefgrobep against Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly, and the degrader field is attracting many entrants.
team: Vlad Coric is Chairman and CEO; Matthew Buten is CFO. Bruce Car moved from CSO to part-time Chief Innovation Officer effective Jul 13, 2026, and David Pirman was promoted to EVP and Head of Discovery. John Yetimoglu joined the board on Aug 6, 2026. Advisors on the SK deal were J.P. Morgan and Sullivan and Cromwell.
market_strategy: Biohaven monetizes platforms through partners instead of building commercial infrastructure. It licensed the whole Kv7 platform including opakalim to SK Biopharmaceuticals for up to $795M plus royalties, keeping non-dilutive capital while cutting go-forward burn, and it deepens oncology ties with Regeneron while prioritizing MoDE and TRAP degraders in immunology.
bull: SK Biopharmaceuticals licensed the Kv7/opakalim platform for up to $795M including $400M near-term cash (Aug 26, 2026), non-dilutive, with RISE3 topline due 2H 2026 and BHV-1530 Phase 1 data at ESMO October 2026.
bear: FDA partial clinical hold letter dated Sep 4, 2026 paused new BHV-7000 enrollment; shares fell ~17% Sep 10. RBC cut to Sector Perform, target $23->$19 Sep 8. Cash $270.5M vs ~$100.8M quarterly R&D leaves under three quarters runway.
falsifier: If the FDA escalates the Sep 4, 2026 partial hold to a full clinical hold on BHV-7000, or RISE3 topline slips past the stated 2H 2026 window, the bull case fails.
web_what_changed: Last 90 days: Jul 9 CSO Bruce Car moved to part-time Chief Innovation Officer, David Pirman promoted to Head of Discovery; Jul 27 federal jury awarded Biohaven/Yale $4M vs Avilar and RA Capital; Aug 6 board seat for John Yetimoglu; Aug 10 Q2 results cash $270.5M; Aug 26 SK Biopharmaceuticals worldwide license of Kv7 platform/opakalim, up to $795M incl $400M near-term; Sep 4/10 FDA partial clinical hold pausing new BHV-7000 enrollment.
web_not_known_yesterday: Not found. No company disclosure dated Sep 24 or 25 exists that I could read; the newest primary event remains the Sep 4 partial-hold letter reported in the Sep 10 Form 8-K. Sep 22 items were third-party valuation commentary (simplywall.st, directorstalk) and the Sep 17 insider options note. Nothing new since Sep 22.
web_demand_price_volume_mix: Biohaven is pre-revenue: no product sales, so no price, volume or mix. FY2026 consensus revenue near $50M is licensing and milestone income, not end-demand. Growth came from deal economics, notably the SK Biopharmaceuticals $400M near-term cash plus tiered royalties (mid-teens to low twenties on US opakalim net sales).
web_suppliers: No disclosed constraint. Clinical supply and drug substance come from contract manufacturers and CROs. Regeneron supplies cemiplimab (Libtayo) for the BHV-1530 and BHV-1510 combination studies. Knopp Biosciences is the Kv7 licensor holding up to $185M approval milestones plus a mid-single-digit royalty, obligations SK Biopharmaceuticals assumes.
web_customers: No commercial customers exist because nothing is approved. The only material counterparty is SK Biopharmaceuticals, which owes upfront, milestone and royalty payments on opakalim, so revenue concentration on one licensee is effectively total. Eventual end-demand would be focal-epilepsy patients and payers, plus IgAN and Graves disease populations in the degrader programs.
web_who_loses: Kv7 and epilepsy competitors lose share if opakalim wins: Xenon Pharmaceuticals (azetukalner), UCB, Jazz and Neurocrine. In IgA nephropathy: Vera, Novartis, Otsuka and Roche. In obesity, Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly if taldefgrobep alfa preserves lean mass. Avilar Therapeutics and RA Capital already lost the trade-secret verdict on Jul 27, 2026.
web_contradicting_evidence: The FDA issued a partial clinical hold letter dated Sep 4, 2026 pausing new BHV-7000 enrollment over rodent metabolite findings of uncertain human significance, and shares fell about 17 percent on Sep 10. RBC cut to Sector Perform and lowered its target to $19 from $23 on Sep 8, citing fading catalysts; BofA is Sell $11, H.C. Wainwright Hold $10. Cash of $270.5M against about $100.8M quarterly R&D leaves roughly under three quarters of runway, and opakalim upside is now capped at royalties.
web_if_management_right: RISE3 topline in focal epilepsy reads out positive in 2H 2026, triggering SK milestones and an NDA path through SK Life Science. BHV-1300 Phase 3 in Graves disease and the BHV-1400 pivotal IgAN study advance, taldefgrobep alfa obesity data follow in 2H 2026, and the $400M non-dilutive cash plus lower burn re-rates the MoDE and TRAP degrader platform.
web_if_management_wrong: If the rodent metabolite finding proves relevant to humans, the FDA hold widens from new enrollment to full clinical hold, RISE3 topline slips past 2H 2026, and SK may delay or reprice the deal before HSR clearance. With about $270.5M of cash and roughly $100M quarterly R&D, Biohaven would then need a dilutive equity raise or a second asset sale.
web_second_order_beneficiaries: Knopp Biosciences collects up to $185M in approval milestones plus a royalty, now payable by SK. SK Biopharmaceuticals and its XCOPRI epilepsy franchise gain an adjacent asset and pipeline optionality. Regeneron benefits from expanded cemiplimab combination work, CROs and CDMOs win trial and manufacturing volume, and Yale University shares the $4M trade-secret award.
